articles.title: Valmet Oyj (HLSE:VALMT) Lands Full Board Line Order For 2029 Asian Startup
articles.summary: Valmet Oyj (HLSE:VALMT) has received a major order for a complete board making line from a leading Asian coated board producer. The delivery includes stock preparation, board machine, automation, digital services, machine clothing, and spare parts as an integrated package. Start up of the new coated board line is planned for 2029, with Valmet responsible for the full delivery scope.
